You can set rhipe_map_buff_size much higher here or just leave it out.

4 map<-expression({
5 y<-do.call("rbind",map.values)
6 y<-y[order(y$page.views,decreasing=TRUE), ]
7 # d<-data.frame()
8 # for( i in 1:10) d<-rbind(d,y[i, ])
9 rhcollect(1,y)
10 })

No need for 7,8. You just want to collect y[1:min(10,nrow(y),,drop=FALSE]
See this code. I need the first 1500 (by time) .

## map.values[[r]] is a data frame of 20 columns, one of which timeOfPacket
## I need the first 1500 packets (by time)
m <- expression({
lapply(seq_along(map.keys),function(r){
v <- map.values[[r]]
first1500 <- v[order(v$timeOfPacket)[1:min(nrow(v), 1500)],,drop=FALSE]
rhcollect(1,first1500)
})
})
r <- expression(
pre={
first1500 <- NULL
},
reduce={
first1500.x<- do.call("rbind", reduce.values)
first1500 <- rbind(first1500,first1500.x)
first1500 <-
first1500[order(first1500$timeOfPacket)[1:min(nrow(first1500),
1500)],]
},
post={
rhcollect(reduce.key,first1500)
}
)
